title: [Crash] System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception: Error creating window handle.
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.ComponentModel.Win32Exception`
**Message:** Error creating window handle.

### Stack Trace
```
   at void System.Windows.Forms.NativeWindow.CreateHandle(CreateParams cp)
   at void System.Windows.Forms.Control.CreateHandle()
   at HWND System.Windows.Forms.Control.Windows.Win32.Foundation.IHandle<Windows.Win32.Foundation.HWND>.get_Handle(?)
   at object System.Windows.Forms.Control.MarshaledInvoke(Control caller, Delegate method, object...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: Root cause identified from the stack trace. When a VNC tab is torn down while its window handle is already gone (app shutdown closing tabs, or a connection that dropped mid-close), the library's screen-update thread stayed alive; when the connection then broke, the library marshaled the "connection lost" event with `Control.Invoke` onto a control that no longer had a window — and `Invoke` on a handle-less control *creates* the handle mid-teardown, which is the fatal `Error creating window handle...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Closing this: the fix is now in a stable release, [v1.84.0](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/v1.84.0).

What shipped (8297ccd90): when a VNC tab is torn down after its window handle is already gone, the VNC library's update thread is now stopped directly, and its "connection lost" callback is silenced before it can try to create a window on a control that no longer has one — the `Error creating window handle` in this report.
